script.speaker: student
script.text: My printing card says zero, but I only printed a few pages this week.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: The quota resets on the first of the month, not on Monday. A lot of people get that wrong.

script.speaker: student
script.text: So the pages I printed last week came out of this month's quota?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Exactly. And colour pages count as three. That is usually where it goes.

question.stem: What is the main reason the student's quota is empty?

options.B: The quota is reset every Monday
options.C: A colour poster used up most of the quota
options.D: The library office made a mistake
options.E: She has not printed anything this month

question.explain_tr: Renkli sayfalar üç sayfa sayılıyor ve öğrenci afiş bastırmış; asıl kota oradan gitmiş. Kotanın pazartesi sıfırlandığı bilgisi ise yanlış, ayın biri sıfırlanıyor.
question.key_line: And colour pages count as three.
